caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate glass decanter with a round, bulbous body that is predominantly red in color and covered with raised, clear oval or round protrusions. The neck of the decanter is also red, narrowing and then flaring out at the mouth, which is outlined with a darker red rim. Around the middle and near the top of the neck are two horizontal bands composed of transparent, ruffled glass. The decanter has a clear glass handle attached to its upper body and neck, curving gracefully. The stopper at the top is faceted and transparent, resembling a cut crystal. The entire composition is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or decorative elements present.
title: Vinegar Cruet
